articles.summary: A tiny gap made a big difference in Baku. Cameron McEvoy won a 50-metre freestyle race in 20.22 seconds and broke the Swimming World Cup record.
articles.title: A Swim Decided by Four Hundredths of a Second

articles.summary: Being ahead did not make the match easy. Carlos Alcaraz lost four games in a row in the second set, then adjusted and won his Japan Open first-round match.
articles.title: Alcaraz Changes His Game After Losing a Lead

articles.summary: A magical hat, two worried siblings and a new song set up an animated adventure. A fresh trailer introduces The Cat in the Hat before its planned North American release on November 6.
articles.title: The Cat in the Hat Returns With a Song and a New Trailer
